match.questionText: Discuss the challenges faced by MSMEs in India and the government initiatives to address them.

points.text: States the significance of MSMEs: share of GDP, exports or employment
Limited access to formal, affordable credit (collateral requirements, credit gap)
Delayed payments from large buyers and government strain working capital
Technology and skill gaps limit productivity and competitiveness
Large informal segment outside formal registration, tax and credit systems
Market access, branding or export competitiveness constraints
Credit support schemes such as MUDRA loans or the credit guarantee scheme (CGTMSE / ECLGS)
Payment-delay remedies such as TReDS or the MSME Samadhaan portal
Formalisation through Udyam registration or the revised MSME definition
Market access through the GeM portal or public procurement policy
Concrete way forward, e.g. cash-flow based lending, cluster development, enforcing payment timelines
